driver_resolution_notes: Project is React Native (Expo dev client); com.holocron.app installed on booted iPhone 17 (C79BF38C-D353-46A2-A1ED-CCA6D68E1B04); Metro on :8081; platform bun service on :4545; Postgres on :5432.

The installed verify-gate-evidence.sh (case statement lines 225-310) has handlers ONLY for exit_and_log_regex, locator_text_regex, and manual — there is NO maestro_native handler, and references/run-maestro-step.sh is absent from this skill install. Therefore a native iOS step can only be machine-certified via a real shell command (maestro test <flow>) under exit_and_log_regex.

The project ships exactly ONE native driver for the upload lifecycle: .maestro/upload.yaml (the all-in-one journey). SPRINT.md step 7 is explicitly 'run that journey'. Steps 2/3/5 are the decomposed native sub-actions (attach / submit / idempotent re-submit) with NO distinct scoped Maestro flows; step 6's voice-cancel action has NO Maestro flow at all. The skill forbids reusing the all-in-one flow as evidence for multiple steps, and authoring new flows is out of scope (no test modification). Those steps are therefore wiring_gap.

Step 7's literal_cmd is the real production native invocation (maestro test), analogous to run-ui-step.mjs for web; it is NOT a wholesale test-suite runner (is_test_suite_cmd does not match 'maestro test').
